name: Granola
description: Bring meeting notes, decisions, and action items into your work.

setup.title: Connect Granola
setup.description: Sign in with your Granola account. No API key or developer application is needed.
steps: Check your account email and active workspace in Granola.
Continue to Granola, sign in with that account, and review the requested access.
Return to OpenTeam after authorization. Granola uses your active workspace; available notes and tools depend on your plan and workspace settings.

skills.name: granola-context
skills.description: Find meeting discussions, decisions, and relevant upcoming conversations with links to the evidence.

skills.name: granola-prep
skills.description: Prepare a meeting brief from previous discussions, open commitments, and recent developments.

skills.name: granola-review
skills.description: Compare an implementation, document, or plan with the requirements and decisions recorded in meetings.
